item.title: infra: New phishing domain viewsroom.org — registered 2026-10-11 NameCheap, Cloudflare (A 172.67.142.230 / 104.21.39.34). Site
item.description: New phishing domain viewsroom.org — registered 2026-10-11 NameCheap, Cloudflare (A 172.67.142.230 / 104.21.39.34). Site titles itself 'Viewsroom | The Reuters Breakingviews podcast', lists @viewsroomshow as official X, and pitches 30-45 min Microsoft Teams guest interviews with a 50% revenue share. Used in @ViewsroomJona impersonation. Official podcast is reuters.com/podcasts/viewsroom/.

new_operator: NEW operator @ViewsroomJona (Jonathan Guilford) — successor to suspended @jonathonGuil. Confirmed as the DMing account v
item.description: NEW operator @ViewsroomJona (Jonathan Guilford) — successor to suspended @jonathonGuil. Confirmed as the DMing account via @EleanorTerrett screenshot (blue, joined August 2026, 8.6k followers, bio claims Reuters columnist / co-host of @viewsroomshow, link viewsroom.org). Already SUSPENDED as of 18 Nov lookup. Official handle @JMAGuilford is NOT an operator.

item.title: warning: NEW victim warning @EleanorTerrett 18 Nov 02:07Z: impersonator of Reuters journalist Jonathan Guilford / Viewsroom podca
item.description: NEW victim warning @EleanorTerrett 18 Nov 02:07Z: impersonator of Reuters journalist Jonathan Guilford / Viewsroom podcast DMed her last week (Patrick McHenry interview). Screenshot identifies @ViewsroomJona (blue, joined Aug 2026, 8.6k followers, viewsroom.org). She also called @viewsroomshow a fake page. Same podcast + Microsoft Teams MO as @jonathonGuil. Official editor @JMAGuilford is NOT an operator.
